model.name: Business Capability Map (starter)
model.documentation: A two-level business capability map for a mid-sized organisation, independent of industry. Capabilities describe what the business does, never how or by whom, so the map stays stable while processes, teams and systems change underneath it. Rename, merge and extend the second level to match your organisation; keep the first level to roughly eight areas so it fits on one page for executives. Each capability carries two properties for a heat map: strategic importance and current maturity.
